question: What is the average price of companies with a change greater than 2?

steps.description: Locate the Chg.(%) column in the table and read the percentage change value for GrowGeneration (GRWG)
Locate the Chg.(%) column in the table and read the percentage change value for Bright Green (BGXX)
Compare the Chg.(%) values from step_1 and step_2 to identify which companies have percentage change greater than 2
Locate the Price column in the table and read the price value for GrowGeneration (GRWG)
Locate the Price column in the table and read the price value for Bright Green (BGXX)
Add together the price values from step_4 and step_5
Count how many companies from step_3 meet the criteria of having Chg.(%) greater than 2
Divide the sum from step_6 by the count from step_7 to get the average price
